name: tutoreval_gemini3_v1
status: FINALIZED tutoreval judge config (best MCC + 0% false-pass + cheapest; matches biggen)
adapter_note: v1 = evidence-first (JSON order: evidence, rationale, verdict). Same config as biggen; both scaling targets converge on gemini-3 + v1. (tutorbench differs: gemini-3 truncates there.)
max_tokens_note: gemini-3 verbose; 4096 gives 0 unscorable on tutoreval.
parser: regex verdict extraction ("verdict":"pass|fail") with json.loads fallback; fail-closed
auto_fail_policy: generation error / empty / missing -> fail WITHOUT a judge call; length-truncated -> graded
selection_rationale: gemini-3 best on the 100-cell tutoreval gold: MCC 0.703, macro-F1 82.8, 0% false-pass, 0 unscorable, most stable, cheapest. No Qwen baseline (no local matrix). Caveat: over-strict (false-fail 45% on 20 gold-pass cells, noisy).
